item.title: Congratulations to Dr. Davide Luciano for successfully defending his PhD
item.description: August 2026 — Congratulations to Dr. Davide Luciano for successfully defending his PhD on 25.08.26! 🥳

item.title: The group at the 15th Carbohydrate Bioengineering Meeting in Elsinore
item.description: May 2026 — The group traveled to Elsinore, Denmark for the 15th Carbohydrate Bioengineering Meeting. Davide and Julian presented posters and Susanne had a talk on NMR of CBM92.

item.title: Welcome to Julian Wegner
item.description: March 2025 — Welcome to Julian! Julian Wegner started in the group and is doing a PhD in biotechnology for engineering bacterial polysaccharides.

item.title: BMMW2024 was a success
item.description: September 2024 — BMMW2024 was a success! Despite stormy weather at Sola Strand, we had 3 days of insightful presentations, lively discussions, and practical exercises on MD simulations and NMR spectroscopy. Huge thanks to all participants, organizers, and BioCat for their support!
